credits: Original pixel art for Verdant Reach, hand-pixelled in tools/art/crystal/fireweed.py. Drawn under the Crystal rule (docs/CREATURES.md); no sprite from any other game was copied, traced or imported.
notes: Crystal rule. BOBBING: a slender red-violet seed pod on its stalk, split at the top into four valves curled back like arms, a tuft of silky white seed hairs billowing out of it at the foe, one seed already adrift. Gesture: the tuft swells, then PUFFS: three seeds launch at the foe and drift up and away. Two hues: the red-violet stem and pod in the dark slot, fireweed magenta in the light slot. Sport: f. albiflorum.
